non desinam, qvam exactissime exaratam. De

qve hujus numeri figura non satis bene
mihi perspicua fuit, licet priori
potius modo qvam secundo exaratam fuisse
exi-stimem, qvo qvidem anno tibi persvades

nongentesimo & vigesimo regni Ismaëli-
tarum, non facile tibi assentior: hoc
e-nim mihi certo constat, annum servato-
ris nostri 1622. qvo ipse in Perside eram,
anno Ismaëlitarum 1031. majori ex par-
te respondisse, qvemadmodum

da-tis postqvam Romam reversus fui,

Muhammedanorum Hegiræ anno

te perpendamus, nec non Ismaëlitarum

page.notes: The line break after "annum" in "annum servato-ris" appears to have no visible space in the scan; I have read it as two words. Long s has been rendered as s throughout. Printed spellings such as qvod, qvam and qvi are kept as printed. The small dots scattered in the margins and the stains at the bottom are not text and are omitted.
